motivation: Original M95 has independent per-token FFNs on original pooled three-level banks. APF tests a direct joint original-ancestry factor with distinct output roles. Original raw aggregation and downstream HCG already provide context; no task deficit or zero-context claim is inferred.

formula.F_i: GELU(W concat(z0_i,z1_p(i),z2_q(p(i)))) in R^(3C), one shared default Linear3C->3C, one original GELU
formula.fine_delta: u_i at each true fine original ID
formula.middle_delta: equal mean of v_i over true fine children of that original middle ID
formula.coarse_delta: equal mean of w_i over all true fine descendant paths of that original coarse ID, directly, not mean of middle means
formula.refined_l: original raw_l + delta_l, one existing outer skip each; original HCG and single native inst_feats writeback retained

graph_hypothesis: One simultaneous ternary raw-ancestry factor, direct fine output and two private upper message reductions may be a useful alternative factorization of hierarchy context. It changes capacity and degree weighting too; no single-factor causal or efficacy conclusion.
boundaries: One path per point-supported fine token, deduplicating point IDs; original ids1/ids2 membership and original IDs remain unchanged.
No true path => zero deltas, no map/GELU invocation. Singleton path uses all three real original-level vectors, no fake/sentinel parent.
Unsupported/pad deltas are zero and retain raw skip. Unlike original full-bank FFNs this does not preserve their unsupported-row bias response; no phantom factor is created.
Coarse private mean is fine-token-path weighted, not equal-middle and not physical-point-mass weighted. Raw mean/FPS/CSORT banks stay unchanged.

closest_routes.BEC: Two-input edge maps, upward private means, original coarse FFN then two downward nonlinear maps. APF has one raw3input nonlinear factor and simultaneous3output roles; fine does not read newly aggregated upper messages.
closest_routes.CCP: Old parent/ancestor additive context is not a joint ternary nonlinear factor and no3split private aggregation.
closest_routes.lite_agg: Old point+mean learned scalar/softmax alters raw pooling; APF keeps raw pools, has no learned pooling score and only private fixed means of new vector messages.
closest_routes.CRE: Cross-root receiver/sender edge vectors and ancestor decoders, unlike within-original-path triplets.
closest_routes.HPC: Whole-forest linear resolvent before/after original3FFNs, unlike direct per-path joint factor replacing3FFNs.
closest_routes.CTS_BFC_AEF: Same-parent state propagation/flux, not a simultaneous original3level path factor.

family: Neural hyperedge/factor aggregation family acknowledged. Literature novelty NOT_VERIFIED; finite historical scope is not exhaustive.
matched_control: Original M95 exact native YAML/data/pretrain/seed1999/precision/optimizer/50epochs/max_iters70 and same original first2TRAIN batches/resource handlers.
